briefings.heading: Clean the data
briefings.body: Flood relief requests are pouring in, but the data is messy. Sort each record: keep it, fix it or trash it.

briefings.heading: Teach the machine to see
briefings.body: Relief teams need an AI, a program that learns from examples, to spot supplies in photos. Label each picture to teach it.

briefings.heading: Build the logic
briefings.body: A supply truck is ready at the depot. Snap together simple steps to guide it to every family, avoiding flooded roads.

briefings.heading: Keep it alive
briefings.body: Everyone needs the relief app at once. Keep its servers (the computers that run it) online so no request gets dropped.
